channel.title: Joe — Vendor Security Advisories
channel.description: Security advisories and PSIRTs from network and infrastructure vendors in use.

item.title: 🟠 Header injection in captive portal authentication form
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.

CVSSv3 Score: 3.1

An Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Response Splitting') vulnerability [CWE-113] in FortiOS and FortiProxy captive portal may allow an attacker able to intercept and modify a user's authentication request to inject arbitrary headers via crafted HTTP requests.

Revised on 2026-07-14 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 5d ago

item.title: 🟠 Unauthenticated VNC access exposed on all interfaces
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.

CVSSv3 Score: 7.7

An Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere vulnerability [CWE-668] in FortiSandbox may allow an unauthenticated attacker to access the VNC server of VMs performing scanning via network requests.

Revised on 2026-07-14 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 5d ago

item.title: 🟠 Buffer overread in authd and wad daemon
item.description:
Why this matters: Vendor advisory — check installed firmware/software version and patch status.

CVSSv3 Score: 4.1

A buffer over-read vulnerability [CWE-126] in FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSASE may allow an authenticated remote attacker to return a portion of device memory in the redirect response via submitting a specially crafted request.

item.title: 🟠 Supers override fails to properly override supervisor address
